datasets.source_name: NOAA Climate Prediction Center / Physical Sciences Laboratory

variables.name: oni_index
variables.definition: 3-month running mean of ERSST.v5 SST anomalies in the Niño 3.4 region (5°N–5°S, 120°–170°W).

datasets.license_usage_notes: Public domain (US Government work / NOAA NCEI open data)
datasets.processing_notes: Parsed from monthly fixed-width table, filtered to panel observation years, aggregated to annual calendar-year mean.

datasets.source_name: Open-Meteo Historical Weather Archive API (ECMWF ERA5 / IMD reanalysis)

variables.name: rainfall_mm
variables.definition: Sum of daily precipitation at geographic centroids of Indian agricultural states.

variables.name: avg_temperature_c
variables.definition: Average 2-meter air temperature over the calendar year.

datasets.license_usage_notes: Open-Meteo API Terms: Open database license (ODbL) / ECMWF ERA5 Copernicus
datasets.processing_notes: Queried per state centroid coordinates with Asia/Kolkata timezone, daily readings aggregated to annual sums/means.

datasets.source_name: Reserve Bank of India (RBI) & MoSPI Directorate of Economics and Statistics

variables.name: agricultural_gva_cr
variables.full_name: Gross State Value Added (GSVA) from Agriculture, Forestry and Fishing at Constant Prices
variables.definition: Official state-level agricultural economic output measure. Measured at constant prices to eliminate price inflation distortions.

datasets.license_usage_notes: National Data Sharing and Accessibility Policy (NDSAP) / Government of India open data
datasets.processing_notes: Standardized across state reclassifications and price base shifts. Linked on (state, year) with meteorological observations.
